local_norm_gate.proof: For primitive r=(x,y), q(r) divides 2I(r), with I(r)=(a*x,(y,K12^2)).  The Smith form of K12^2 is 1^12,3^12. Away from (2),(3) and the squarefree support of a, primitivity forces zero norm valuation.  At an odd coefficient prime P the valuation is zero or one, and the positive case forces y in P*K12^2.  At (3) the valuation is zero or one and the positive case forces all spatial pairings to be divisible by 3.  At inert (2), evenness gives valuation zero or one for odd a and exactly one when v_2(a)=1.  Class number one and U^+=U^2 give the canonical products used below.
